parameters.query: ={{ (() => { const conds = [ $json.contact.phone ? { phone: $json.contact.phone } : null, $json.contact.email ? { email: { $regex: '^' + $json.contact.email + '$', $options: 'i' } } : null ].filter(Boolean); return JSON.stringify(conds.length ? { $or: conds } : { _id: null }); })() }}
